criteria.statement: Navigation model exposes five icon-bearing sections: Workspace, Delivery, Operations, Intelligence, and Admin.
DNS and Notifications routes are present in Operations.
PRIMARY_NAV_LINKS is no longer exported or rendered by Nav.svelte.
currentLocation(pathname) derives section, page, and icon from NAV_SECTIONS.
Nav.svelte places the menu trigger left of the logo, renders a breadcrumb after the logo, and opens navigation as a left-side drawer with backdrop.
